App icon concepts

Branding·by @dmiiiitrii·2026-08-27·inspora page·original post

What it is

Static 3x3 grid of app icon concepts: nine squircle explorations of one mascot/brand (blue ghost blob, gradient explosion star, purple blob on rainbow, neon green splat, sky scribble, gradient orb, purple smiley with earring, monochrome S-mark, orange owl-face).

Media

Frame-by-frame

image
Nine app-icon renders on tinted backdrop tiles: soft 3D blob mascot variants (glossy gradients, inner glows, drop shadows) and flat graphic variants (splat, scribble, S monogram). Each squircle centered on a solid or gradient tile.

Build prompt

Recreate a 3x3 app-icon exploration board. Each cell: a tinted backdrop tile (solid or soft gradient) with a centered 180px squircle icon (iOS continuous corners, floor shadow). Icon recipes: (1) sky-blue gradient squircle, white soft blob rising from bottom edge with two oval eyes, heavy blur edges; (2) black squircle, jagged starburst with pink-orange-yellow vertical gradient + two eyes; (3) rainbow soft-gradient squircle, dark violet blob mascot with two eyes; (4) neon green squircle, white splat with thick black outline + face; (5) sky photo squircle with white outlined scribble ghost; (6) deep purple squircle, iridescent gradient orb with two eyes; (7) lavender squircle, purple glossy blob with smile + green stud earring; (8) off-white squircle, black abstract S of two comma shapes; (9) white squircle, orange glossy sphere owl-face. Eyes everywhere are pairs of vertical ovals, slightly tilted.
